svg.title: Nodes — Loom control center prototype
svg.desc: A full-width node inventory with one control-wide bootstrap SSH identity and a clear entry point to a separate onboarding page, distinct from platform signing trust and node-local WireGuard identity.

g.text: Monitor trusted node state · host-key-guarded enrollment on the control node
Declared hosts and their newest trusted observation
Declared endpoint is SSOT intent; UDP ingress remains unverified. Durable management host/user remain a control-inventory gap.
Fingerprint SHA256:AbCdEf123456…Example · generated once and reused by every enrollment.
Private key stays on the control node · separate from platform signing trust and node WG identity.
The same public key authorizes every bootstrap
Revoke separately after Agent/TLS bootstrap, if desired
